Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

About Agoda

Agoda is an online travel booking platform for accommodations, flights, and more. We build and deploy cutting‑edge technology that connects travelers with a global network of 4.7M hotels and holiday properties worldwide, plus flights, activities, and more. Based in Asia and part of Booking Holdings, our 7,100+ employees representing 95+ nationalities in 27 markets foster a work environment rich in diversity, creativity, and collaboration. We innovate through a culture of experimentation and ownership, enhancing the ability for our customers to experience the world.

Our Purpose – Bridging the World Through Travel

We believe travel allows people to enjoy, learn and experience more of the amazing world we live in. It brings individuals and cultures closer together, fostering empathy, understanding and happiness.

We are a skillful, driven and diverse team from across the globe, united by a passion to make an impact. Harnessing our innovative technologies and strong partnerships, we aim to make travel easy and rewarding for everyone.

Scope

As a Localization Specialist, you will be the owner of translation technology within our team, ensuring that Agoda’s products and communications are efficiently and accurately localized into 38 languages. You will manage and optimize translation workflows, implement automation, and leverage the latest machine translation and large language model (LLM) solutions. Your role will be critical in driving operational excellence, supporting translators, and ensuring the highest quality of localized content through data‑driven analysis and continuous process improvement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and manage translation technology, including CAT tools, translation management system, and related integrations.
  • Operate and optimize translation workflows, ensuring efficiency, scalability, and quality.
  • Implement and maintain automation solutions to streamline localization processes.
  • Evaluate, deploy, and support the latest machine translation and LLM‑based translation solutions.
  • Collaborate with translators, project managers, and other stakeholders to resolve technical issues and improve localization outcomes.
  • Analyze localization data and KPIs to identify trends, troubleshoot issues, and drive continuous improvement.
  • Develop and maintain localization guidelines, best practices, and technical documentation.
  • Support vendor onboarding and technical integration.
  • Ensure localization processes are reliable and aligned with industry standards.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

  • Strong analytical skills and a data‑driven approach to problem‑solving.
  • Experience operating translation workflows and managing localization technology.
  • Hands‑on experience with automation in localization, including scripting or workflow automation tools.
  • Familiarity with machine translation engines, LLM‑based translation solutions, and CAT tools.
  • Ability to troubleshoot technical issues and communicate solutions to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
  • Experience in a global, fast‑paced environment, ideally in e‑commerce or technology.
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills.
  • Fluency in English required; additional language skills are a plus.

title: eCommerce Creative CRO Designer

Native Pet is a pet nutrition company based in St. Louis, Missouri, creating organic, highly effective, and limited-ingredient supplements for dogs and cats. Our products use wholefood and superfood ingredients to harness nature’s healing powers and support the health and well-being of pets. We’re a hybrid company with a passionate team that values flexibility, creativity, and continuous growth as we build a world-class brand.

Job Summary

We are seeking a Creative Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Designer to drive improvements in click-through rate (CTR) and conversion rate (CVR) across our Amazon & TikTok Shop listings. This is a global remote opportunity. This role is focused on creative optimization—crafting, testing, and refining images and content to maximize performance. The ideal candidate combines strong design ability with an analytical mindset, using poll feedback and performance data to produce visuals that convert.

This position will collaborate closely with our marketing and Amazon teams to elevate the visual storytelling and performance of our product pages.

Key Responsibilities

  • Improve CTR & CVR: Lead ongoing optimization efforts for Amazon listings through creative testing and design updates.
  • Main Image Design: Create and refine high-performing main images using poll feedback (via Intellivy or ProductPinion).
  • Carousel Image Design: Develop persuasive and visually consistent carousel content based on poll and performance data.
  • A+ Content Design: Design engaging, informative, and on-brand A+ content to improve conversion rates and customer understanding.
  • Ad & Storefront Support: Collaborate on Sponsored Brand creatives, DSP assets, and storefront design to ensure brand alignment.
  • TikTok & External Creative: Design main images and creatives for TikTok or external traffic campaigns where necessary.
  • Creative Testing: Collaborate with team members to plan, analyze, and implement test outcomes into new creative iterations.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Proven design experience, ideally within Amazon or eCommerce environments.
  • Proficiency in Figma (preferred) or Canva for rapid creative iteration.
  • Strong portfolio showcasing design work focused on performance or direct-response results.
  • Excellent attention to visual detail, consistency, and brand cohesion.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with Amazon creative formats (main image, A+ content, carousel, Sponsored Brand, and Storefront).
  • Experience using polling and testing tools such as Intellivy or ProductPinion.
  • Understanding of eCommerce CRO principles (CTR, CVR, and visual hierarchy).
  • Basic familiarity with data-driven creative testing and split testing.

What You’ll Gain

  • Opportunity to directly influence the performance of a fast-growing Amazon brand.
  • Experience collaborating across design, analytics, and marketing teams.
  • A creative environment that values experimentation, data-driven insights, and visual storytelling.

Context & Environment

O Brasil é um país altamente regulado, com exigências rigorosas de SSMS e necessidade de demonstração de gestão de riscos às autoridades como pré-requisito obrigatório para qualquer operação. A TotalEnergies EP Brasil é uma afilial estratégica para o Grupo, em fase de crescimento (200 mil bpd em participação do Grupo até 2025). A excelência na gestão de riscos operacionais contribui para a expansão do portfólio operado e para o aumento da influência sobre os parceiros responsáveis por ativos estratégicos operados por terceiros (OBOs). A excelência em SSMS, Segurança e Integridade garante a sustentabilidade da reputação da TotalEnergies no Brasil, ao mesmo tempo em que preserva a vida de todos os envolvidos.

Atividades

Realizar suas atividades em conformidade com o Sistema de Gestão de HSE, alinhado aos Princípios do OneMAESTRO, visando preservar o meio ambiente e os recursos, contribuindo para a melhoria da eficiência energética e descarbonização dos ativos da empresa.

  • Participar de estudos de perigos e avaliações de riscos para garantir a execução segura dos programas operacionais.

    1. preparação de operações de içamento,

    3. prevenção de lesões nas mãos,
    4. operações simultâneas e

description:
About Us

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 122 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building.

Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human.

Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page

Business Analysts at Nubank

As a company at the forefront of the financial revolution in Brazil, Nubank has experienced exponential growth since its inception. To keep your growth path healthy, numerous critical decisions constantly need to be made. Business Analysts are fundamental in the decision process because they must not only be able to deal with large amounts of information and data, but also always think of ways to improve our clients' experience.

It is BA's responsibility to structure the data, analyze it and use the results to test different solutions with the aim of improving Nubank's efficiency.

We are looking for people who are independent and who are not afraid to take the initiative to identify and solve problems that are not necessarily obvious.

You can read more about it in our blog and get some insights into how we work.

As a Business Analyst, you’re expected to:

  • Do a lot of investigative work, focused on deciding which data makes the most sense to use in which situation. If you don't have the data, it's your job to think about what tests can be done or how to extract the information you need to answer your questions;
  • Support your team in making data-based decisions by monitoring analysis and decisions, ensuring the flow of projects and making the process of taking risks comfortable despite the uncertainties;
  • Learning how to work with a large volume of data to build a solid foundation for decision making with calculated risks - even knowing that not all the answers are in the data and/or that not all the data you would like is available; Use tools like SQL, Python and Scala - taught during your first weeks with us - for data extraction;
  • Understand our products and interactions with other areas;
  • Take advantage of opportunities to grow and learn from a well-prepared and highly qualified team;
  • Opportunity to work in a complex, dynamic and diverse environment, participating in projects that will impact a large number of clients.

What are we looking for?

  • Analytical capacity: ease with numbers and calculations, having the ability to solve problems mathematically;
  • Business basics: dynamics between risks and opportunities, as well as interaction between business areas and technical areas (products/engineering);
  • Problem solving: ease and creativity to seek solutions to day-to-day challenges and achieve the best results;
  • Ability to understand how your decisions and work impact our customers' experience, seeking results that align with our purpose;
  • Willingness and ease of learning, especially for tools;
  • Openness to receive feedback and incorporate it into your daily life and development;
  • Adaptability to the multifunctional environment;
  • Profiles that add value to Nubank's culture.

Fundado em 1961 com a criação da Profarma Distribuição, o Grupo Profarma consolidou-se como um dos líderes no mercado farmacêutico brasileiro, ocupando hoje uma relevante atuação no mercado nacional em distribuição. Seja de forma presencial ou por canais digitais, desenvolvemos soluções e serviços inovadores que nos posicionam como a melhor escolha para nossos parceiros. Acreditamos que enxergar é mais do que ver - é reconhecer as singularidades que tornam cada pessoa única. Por isso, reforçamos nosso compromisso com a Diversidade & Inclusão por meio do programa Diversidade em Cena.

Promovemos um ambiente acolhedor e respeitoso para todos, valorizando as diferenças de gênero, etnia, deficiências, orientação sexual (LGBTI+), crenças, religiões e outras individualidades.

title: Model Risk Specialist
description:
About Us

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 122 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building.

Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human.

Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page .

About The Team

At Nubank we heavily rely on data, machine learning and other quantitative models & techniques to drive our strategy and provide the best experience and products to our customers. The position holder will be part of the Model Risk team, within the Risk Management structure at Nubank.

The Model Risk team is the second line of defense for our models. Our mission is to ensure Nubank relies on world‑class solutions that will lead to optimal and sustainable decisions. We act by providing independent review & challenge to models, staying tuned to cutting edge techniques, along with business, customers and regulatory needs. We also work to identify and control risks related to our models, as well as in the definition and implementation of feedback loops to constantly improve them.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct independent reviews of quantitative models based on various financial, statistical and machine learning techniques, identifying and validating model's uses, hypothesis, data, methodologies and compliance with regulatory requirements.
  • Provide effective challenges, identify risks and enhancement opportunities, and engage with other analysts to strengthen our decision‑making tools.
  • Develop playbooks and toolkits (Python, Scala, LLM, etc.) to optimize model reviews, ongoing models monitoring, and assess the impact of models in decisions.

title: Analista de Suporte N2 – Redes
description:
Analista N2 Pleno

Empresa

Somos um provedor de internet em crescimento, focado em qualidade, estabilidade e atendimento próximo aos nossos clientes.

Missão do cargo

Garantir que a rede funcione de forma estável, resolvendo problemas técnicos de clientes e da infraestrutura, atuando entre o atendimento N1 e a engenharia/N3.

Atividades principais

  • Atender chamados escalados pelo N1 (casos que o N1 não conseguiu resolver).
  • Analisar conectividade:
    • Testes de ping e traceroute (IP e domínio).
    • Identificar se o problema está no cliente, na rede interna, no POP, na rota ou na operadora.
  • Acessar e analisar OLT GPON (ZTE, Huawei, Fiberhome, Nokia ou similar):
    • Ver potência RX/TX das ONUs.
    • Ver ONUs flutuando (online/offline).
    • Verificar erros e utilização das portas GPON.
  • Verificar e ajustar VLAN, PPPoE, IPoE e DHCP:
    • Sessões PPPoE travadas.
    • Cliente autenticando e não navegando.
    • Cliente sem IP ou recebendo IP incorreto.
  • Apoiar o time de campo com diagnóstico técnico (indicar provável ponto de falha).
  • Utilizar ferramentas de monitoramento (Zabbix, Grafana ou similares) para identificar e prevenir instabilidades.
  • Registrar nos chamados o passo a passo do diagnóstico e da solução.

Requisitos técnicos (obrigatórios)

  • Experiência prévia em provedor de internet ou suporte de redes.
  • Bom conhecimento de TCP/IP (IP, máscara, gateway, DNS, rota).
  • Entender bem PPPoE e/ou IPoE.
  • Saber trabalhar com VLAN (ACCESS/TRUNK, tagged/untagged).
  • Noções sólidas de IPv4 e NAT.
  • Uso prático de ping, tracert/traceroute e testes por IP e domínio.
  • Conhecimento básico em ao menos um equipamento de borda, por exemplo: Mikrotik, Cisco, Huawei ou similar.
  • Capacidade de leitura e interpretação de logs (roteador, OLT, servidor PPPoE/DHCP).

Diferenciais (não obrigatórios, mas contam ponto)

  • Experiência com OLT GPON (ZTE, Huawei, Fiberhome, Nokia, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de CGNAT / BNG / BRAS.
  • Experiência com Zabbix, Grafana ou outras ferramentas de monitoramento.
  • Noções de IPv6.
  • Cursos ou certificações em redes (MTCNA, CCNA, etc.).
  • Já trabalhou em provedor de internet.
  • Sabe mexer em OLT GPON na prática (ver potência, ONU, porta, erros).
  • Usa Mikrotik ou similar no dia a dia.
  • Consegue resolver a maioria dos problemas sem supervisão.
  • Já trabalhou com redes/provedor.
  • Conce sabe TCP/IP, PPPoE, VLAN.
  • Atua com OLT GPON + Mikrotik + monitoramento (Zabbix/Grafana).
  • Entende bem PPPoE, IPoE, VLAN, NAT, CGNAT/BNG.
  • Consegue segurar plantão e dar suporte ao time como referência técnica.

Perfil comportamental

  • Gosta de resolver problema até o fim, sem “empurrar para o outro”.
  • Sabe trabalhar sob pressão, mantendo calma e foco.
  • Boa comunicação com N1, N3 e técnicos de campo.
  • Organização para registrar tudo o que faz.
  • Vontade de aprender e crescer junto com a empresa.

Jornada / Modelo

  • Regime: CLT – 44h semanais
  • Horário: segunda a sexta, das 09h às 17h
  • Sábado, das 09h às 13h
  • Local: Av Ayrton Senna 3000, Edíficio Itanhanga (Via Parque) – Presencial

description:
Médico Cirurgião Geral - Hospital Municipal Pedro II

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos e dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em psiquiatria e obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Prestar atendimento aos pacientes de acordo com a demanda, efetuando exame físico e hipótese diagnóstica, encaminhando o paciente a exames complementares quando necessário e realizando os procedimentos cirúrgicos indicados, zelando pela conduta e atuação dentro do princípio ético da profissão.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo em Medicina
  • Residência Médica ou Título de Especialista na área
  • Registro ativo no conselho de classe
  • RQE em Cirurgia Geral
  • Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 122 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. At Nubank we heavily rely on data, machine learning and other quantitative models & techniques to drive our strategy and provide the best experience and products to our customers.

The Model Risk team is the second line of defense for our models. Our mission is to ensure Nubank relies on world-class solutions that will lead to optimal and sustainable decisions. Be exposed to different types of decisions and processes (e.g. credit, fraud, operations and in different countries);
Conduct independent reviews of quantitative models based on statistical, machine learning and AI techniques, with a stronger focus on credit models;

Ensure the team maintains a high level of technical excellence.

  • Previous knowledge of expected loss provisions modeling would be a plus.

MÉDICO CIRURGIÃO VASCULAR - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia‑geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

  • Engajar, conhecer e aprender sobre sua área designada, mas não limitando-se à;

  • Colaborar e conectar com diferentes times, estagiários e áreas da Baker Hughes para ter um amplo conhecimento e rede de networking global;
  • Aplicar os conceitos de HSE (Saúde, Segurança e Meio-Ambiente) garantindo e mantendo os procedimentos em todas as situações para um ambiente mais seguro, íntegro e saudável;
  • Participar e engajar em grupos de integração para estagiários e outros Hubs de voluntariado, Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão que alavancarão seu networking e desenvolvimentos de habilidades por todo o Globo.

Saiba mais sobre a área de atuação:

Gestão de Projetos

Auxiliar, também, no acompanhamento junto ao cliente e ao financeiro o recebimento dos pagamentos agendados.

O estagiário trabalhará em assuntos relacionados à novos contratos/projetos do setor, devendo realizar análises críticas de documentações técnicas e minutas, elaborar documentações técnicas, organizar as informações recebidas/atualizadas, analisar/levantar soluções, possíveis riscos ou possíveis gaps técnicos, além de levantar custos relacionados às soluções. Confira a localização da vaga no momento da sua candidatura, já que temos diferentes escritórios espalhados entre as cidades do Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo e Bahia.

Nós sabemos que todos são diferentes e que a maneira de trabalhar e entregar resultados no seu melhor é diferente para cada um. Na Baker Hughes, temos diferentes ambientes de trabalho, que dependem da localização e área de atuação. Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world’s leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‐based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring engineers to work across the breadth of our Ubuntu Engineering organisation — engineers who care deeply for quality, performance and resilience in software, engineers who are just as comfortable with designing and engineering new software as they are with packaging, integrating, testing and shipping the incredible catalog of open source software provided by the Ubuntu repositories.

Our engineers integrate the freshest open source software, provide robust upgrade paths and engineer the future of Ubuntu. Ubuntu is not just the world’s most deployed open source operating system, it’s a platform that enables innovation for millions of users across the globe. Our community represents the full breadth of the developer experience; from students, hobbyists and freelancers to high‑performance engineering and creative teams in corporate and academic environments.

The four key teams that ship Ubuntu are:

  • Foundations : maintaining foundational software: architectures, package managers, compilers, toolchains, bootloaders, filesystems and core utilities
  • Server : leading the design, evolution and future of our Ubuntu Server distribution
  • Desktop : driving Ubuntu Desktop, our future immutable desktop: Ubuntu Core Desktop, WSL, gaming technology, and a suite of modern applications for the desktop crafted with Flutter
  • Debrafters : a new team responsible for the forward movement, maintenance and overall health of the Ubuntu archive: one of the most abundant repositories of open source software available today

Bring your existing expertise and learn new skills by working on one of the most prolific pieces of open source software. As an engineer working on Ubuntu you could work on any or all of the following categories:

  • Development : design, build and ship new foundational systems software and applications in Rust, Go, Flutter, and Python
  • Architecture : engineer the integration of open source from boot firmware to cloud applications deployment
  • Packaging : a combination of Debian and Snap packaging to ship software in the distribution
  • Automation : build and maintain the machinery responsible for building, testing and shipping Ubuntu
  • Distro Engineering : the maintenance and evolution of a Linux distribution and its repositories

This application track is suitable for those at the mid point in their career but perhaps not quite at the Manager/Lead level, with relevant skills to contribute to Ubuntu.

At Canonical, you will have the opportunity to engage with and contribute to the broader open source community. We’re looking for individuals who can help build a thriving community and contribute with enthusiasm and precision to a broad range of technologies.

Location : We have remote roles open in every time zone.

What the role entails

Based on the first round of interviews, we identify specific teams where you might be an excellent fit and conduct second‑round interviews with those teams. Our engineers are:

  • Designing, building and shipping software in Rust, Go and Python
  • Packaging, integrating, testing and uploading open source software to the Ubuntu repositories
  • Debugging system‑level issues and delivering robust solutions
  • Authoring and improving technical and community documentation
  • Contributing to upstream and neighboring open source projects
  • Collaborating as part of a globally distributed team
  • Mentoring their colleagues to build skills and understanding
  • Developing and improving processes to more efficiently fulfil our goals

What we are looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above and beyond expectations
  • A demonstrated passion for open source software
  • Significant experience with Rust, Go, Python, Flutter or C/C++
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each

Nice‑to‑have skills

  • Experience with Linux distributions and distribution engineering
  • Experience with software packaging and distribution mechanisms
  • Understanding of build systems and toolchains, including for cross‑compilation
  • Performance or Security Engineering experience

What we offer you

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence — in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote‑first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Atividades

  • Apresentar-se aos pacientes sob sua responsabilidade no início do plantão, prestando todas as informações necessárias a continuidade do atendimento.
  • Assumir as funções inerentes ao Técnico de Enfermagem Diarista na ausência do mesmo, visando dar continuidade e encaminhamento ao expediente do Setor.
  • Prestar assistência de enfermagem ao paciente internado no setor, realizando diversos procedimentos, tais como: higiene ocular, oral, íntima e corporal, aferição de peso, medir diurese, administrar medicamentos, mudança de decúbito, aspiração de vias aéreas superiores, traqueostomia e tubo oro faríngeo, entre outros, conforme definido nos POPs (Procedimento Operacional Padrão) definidos pela Unidade, visando resolver todas as intercorrências.
  • Separar os materiais necessários e auxiliar os Médicos ou Enfermeiros nos procedimentos realizados, tais como punções venosas profundas, punções arteriais médias, intubações, entre outras, bem como providenciando o descarte dos materiais utilizados.
  • Cumprir os protocolos de assistência criados pela Unidade, aplicando todas as medidas preventivas especificadas, visando garantir a segurança do paciente.
  • Conferir e repor o Carro e Maleta de Parada Cardiorrespiratória, após a utilização em situações emergenciais, a fim de garantir sua prontidão para novas situações.
  • Prestar vigilância intensiva aos pacientes sob seu cuidado, notificando imediatamente aos enfermeiros e registrando na evolução do balanço hídrico qualquer intercorrência, para fins de controle.
  • Cumprir as orientações definidas em prescrição Médica, para preparo dos pacientes para realização de exames e/ou cirurgias, tais como manutenção de jejum, preparo de cólon, entre outros, a fim de garantir a continuidade do tratamento.
  • Observar previsões de altas e possíveis transferências, com objetivo de priorizar os cuidados, agilizando o processo.
  • Instalar no paciente os equipamentos de monitorização, como bombas infusoras e monitores cardíacos, conforme orientação médica.
  • Preparar corpo do paciente nos casos de óbito, a fim de encaminhá‑lo ao morgue.
  • Realizar a aplicação de compressas quentes e frias, conforme prescrição médica, assegurando a integridade cutânea do paciente.
  • Devolver medicações e materiais do cliente em caso de altas, transferências, óbitos ou em caso de modificações de prescrições, todos devidamente identificados com etiqueta do cliente.
  • Providenciar a devolução dos medicamentos e materiais não utilizados pelos pacientes, fazendo lançamento através do Sistema Phostos, garantindo a confirmação do processo.
  • Checar e rubricar todos os medicamentos prescritos e administrados, lançando no balanço hídrico horário de início de dieta, transporte de soluções, infusões, medicações SOS e ACM, assim como valor de glicemia, diurese e eliminações, controlar o balanço hídrico rigorosamente.
  • Verificar os pacientes em precaução de contato, assegurando o bloqueio de entrada, com uso correto e rigoroso de EPIs.
  • Auxiliar os pacientes na ingestão de alimentos, quando necessário.
  • Conferir e testar equipamentos e/ou materiais dos boxes/quartos, sob sua responsabilidade, verificando o perfeito estado de funcionamento e utilização dos mesmos, quando da entrada de novos pacientes.
  • Admitir o paciente junto ao enfermeiro, realizando conferência dos sinais vitais, identificando o cliente com pulseira.
  • Retirar todo material e equipamentos, realizar a higiene dos mesmos e armazená-los em local adequado, em caso de altas, transferências e óbitos.
  • Informar ao enfermeiro plantonista, problemas com equipamentos para que sejam comunicados aos serviços de apoio (engenharia clínica, hotelaria, manutenção predial, supervisão da higiene).
  • Preencher livro de protocolo, no plantão noturno, em caso de empréstimos de equipamento e/ou materiais para outros Setores de Enfermagem.

We strive for state‑of‑the‑art software development practices that currently include a variety of technologies. While we value candidates that are familiar with them, we are also confident that software engineers who are interested in joining Nubank will be able to learn from our team.   • Storing data in Datomic and DynamoDB
  • Monitoring and observability with Prometheus
  • Running as much as possible in Kubernetes

  • Work focused on backend applications, and be open to contribute to mobile and frontend development, according to business needs

We Are Looking For a Person Who Has

  • At least 10 years of experience developing digital products in complex environments
  • Deep expertise in distributed systems, microservices architecture, and cloud technologies
  • Proven track record of designing and delivering large‑scale systems that serve thousands (or even millions) of users

title: Product  Support Specialist - Americas
description:
Swapcard is the leading AI‑powered event platform designed to drive revenue growth and foster meaningful connections at in‑person and hybrid events. We recognize the importance of teamwork in successful events; that’s why Swapcard is fueled by a team of innovators who are passionate about helping organizers build future‑proof events.

Vision

At Swapcard, we believe in the power of meaningful connections. This belief fuels our commitment to pioneering modern solutions that empower organizers to create engaging event experiences. Guided by our commitment to excellence and collaboration, we aim to redefine the landscape of event technology, setting new standards for engagement, accessibility, and impact.

Beliefs

At Swapcard, diversity is at the core of our success. With 42 nationalities represented among our 180+ team members, we champion diversity as a catalyst for creativity, collaboration, and unparalleled innovation. We believe that by embracing a multitude of backgrounds, cultures, and viewpoints, we can truly understand and cater to the needs of our global community of event organizers and participants. Our full remote opportunities empower our team to thrive, no matter where they are in the world, fostering a culture of flexibility and inclusion.

Technical Support Team Overview

The Technical Support team is responsible for educating and empowering Swapcard customers on a global level. Our job starts even before they become our customers: as soon as they visit Swapcard’s website, we are there to guide them through conversations every step of the way to ensure they get the most value out of our product.

Missions and Scope

  • Communicating efficiently and effectively with our customers – we use Intercom conversations to do most of our support, but you’ll also be talking to customers via video calls every now and then (webinars, etc.).
  • Owning customer communications and issues from initial contact until resolution, or escalation to the appropriate SME when needed.
  • Becoming an encyclopedia of knowledge about how Swapcard works and what it is capable of for all user types and plans.
  • Being the one responsible, along with the Success team, to ensure that all customers have a great experience with our platform – a crucial part of the role is ensuring we make Swapcard as intuitive, reliable, bug‑free, and fast as possible.
  • Working directly with Product teams to identify current issues and, synthesizing the diverse feedback you hear from our customers, offer informed opinions on potential solutions.
  • Continuously identifying Help Center content gaps and recording knowledge.

What We Look for

  • Previous experience working in a troubleshooting environment.
  • 1-2 years of technical support experience in English.
  • Solid understanding of tech fundamentals + modern day tools (Slack, Notion, Intercom, JIRA, Gainsight).
  • Understanding of web technologies and concepts (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, APIs, etc.).
  • Ability to troubleshoot and utilize resources to answer questions on baseline topics.
  • Strong customer focus – excels at and enjoys helping customers.
  • Ability to take on and act on feedback.
  • Strong communication skills (ability to question, clarify, empathize, use appropriate tone and language, personable).
  • Excitement for a support environment that is constantly experimenting with workflows and automation to drive efficiency.
  • Strong problem‑solving skills (ability to think critically and learn on‑the‑fly).
  • Demonstrated success working with Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) or other metrics/quotas.

Interview Process

  • Screening Interview with a recruiter from our people team.
  • A remote exercise to demonstrate and assess your skills.
  • Manager review with your future reporting manager.
  • Leadership review with one of our department leaders.
  • Reference check conducted by our people team.
  • Offer.

Values

title: ANALISTA PLENO DE ENGENHARIA DE MONITORAMENTO
description:
Jaé – Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Sobre nós

O Jaé é a plataforma de bilhetagem digital e mobilidade urbana do Rio de Janeiro. Nosso propósito é transformar a experiência de quem utiliza o transporte público, trazendo simplicidade, praticidade e inovação para o dia a dia das pessoas. Com tecnologia própria e serviços de qualidade, oferecemos soluções seguras e acessíveis, que vão desde o pagamento digital de passagens até a gestão integrada de modais. Buscamos profissionais que queiram crescer junto com a gente e fazer parte dessa mudança na mobilidade da cidade.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Planejar, desenvolver e manter soluções de monitoramento e observabilidade de sistemas, aplicações, bancos e infraestrutura;
  • Instrumentar aplicações com métricas, logs e traces (APM), garantindo visibilidade ponta a ponta;
  • Criar e manter dashboards e painéis operacionais (Grafana, Kibana, Zabbix, etc.) para uso pelos times de suporte e operações;
  • Definir e automatizar fluxos de alerta e correlação de eventos, integrando ferramentas de monitoramento a canais de notificação (Teams, Telegram, e-mail, etc.);
  • Trabalhar junto aos times de Infra, Service Desk e Suporte N2 para definir o que e como monitorar, priorizando os sistemas críticos de bilhetagem;
  • Realizar análises de causa raiz (RCA) e propor melhorias baseadas em dados históricos;
  • Apoiar iniciativas de automação de respostas a incidentes (self-healing, scripts, webhooks);
  • Contribuir para a documentação e padronização dos processos de monitoramento.

Requisitos e diferenciais

  • Formação: Superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas da Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência:
    • Experiência prática com ferramentas de monitoramento (Zabbix, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, PRTG, Dynatrace, Datadog, etc.).
    • Conhecimento em APM, logs e métricas de infraestrutura e aplicações.
    • Vivência com alertas e automação de notificações.
    • Conhecimento em sistemas operacionais (Linux e Windows Server).
    • Noções de bancos de dados, redes e containers (Docker/Kubernetes).
  • Conhecimentos desejáveis:
    • Linguagens para automação e scripts (Python, Shell, PowerShell).
    • Integração de monitoramento via APIs e Webhooks.
    • Conhecimento em CI/CD e DevOps para observabilidade em pipelines.
    • Experiência em ambientes de missão crítica (24x7) e alta disponibilidade.

  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica;
  • Seguro de Vida;

Business Development Representative (BDR/SDR)

3 days ago – Be among the first 25 applicants.

Hi there! We are South and our client is looking for a Business Development Representative!

Note To Applicants

  • Eligibility This position is open to candidates residing in Latin America.
  • Application Language: Please submit your CV in English. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered.
  • Professional Presentation: We encourage you to showcase your professional experience by including a Loom video in the application form. While this is optional, candidates who provide a video presentation will be given priority.

About The Role

We are looking for a motivated and ambitious Business Development Representative (BDR/SDR) to drive our next stage of growth. In this role, you’ll work directly with leadership, prospecting and creating opportunities with founders, CEOs, and scaling SMEs. You’ll often be the first voice prospects hear, so clear, confident, and energetic communication is essential. This isn’t just a lead‑generation role—it’s a launchpad. You’ll gain hands‑on experience in full‑cycle sales, from prospecting to closing, and have a clear path to grow into an Account Executive or even a Head of Sales role as the company scales.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute multi‑channel outbound prospecting (email, LinkedIn, cold calls) to targeted founders, executives, and VC partners.
  • Identify and nurture high‑potential prospects that align with our ICP (early‑stage and scaling SMEs).
  • Conduct initial prospect evaluations (funding stage, headcount, people challenges) before booking meetings.
  • Generate qualified meetings for leadership, ensuring a healthy pipeline and consistent deal flow.
  • Leverage tools like PitchBook, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and HubSpot to research and build prospect lists.
  • Communicate our value proposition with clarity and impact across all outreach.
  • Track, update, and manage activity in HubSpot, ensuring smooth handovers and accurate reporting.
  • Continuously test and optimize outreach cadences, messaging, and conversion tactics.

Requirements

  • 2–4 years of experience in outbound sales, BDR/SDR, or business development.
  • Familiarity with the US startup/SME market and experience collaborating with international teams remotely.
  • Confident and engaging on the phone, articulate over email, and persistent without being pushy.
  • Self‑starter who thrives in fast‑paced, high‑growth environments.
  • Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities simultaneously.

Growth Path

  • Full‑cycle sales: from prospecting → discovery → proposal → close.
  • Strategic selling: engaging with CEOs, founders, and investors.
  • Personal brand building: leveraging LinkedIn and content to open doors.
  • Career development: progression into Account Executive within 12–18 months, with potential to grow into sales leadership as the team expands.

Why Join Us?

  • Base salary: USD $1,500/month.
  • Full‑time, remote role (EST hours).
  • Tools: HubSpot, PitchBook, Sales Navigator, ClickUp, Google Suite.
  • Work directly with leadership in a dynamic, founder‑led team.
  • Be part of a scrappy, high‑growth environment where your impact is immediate.
  • Build the foundation for a long‑term career in sales leadership within the VC/startup ecosystem.

If this opportunity sounds good to you, send us your resume!

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

À infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

A unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

  • Realizar exames ultrassonográficos em pacientes externos ou internos, atendendo as solicitações da Unidade.

title: OT Cybersecurity Technical Architect
description:
Join to apply for the OT Cybersecurity Technical Architect role at Voltalia

The OT Cybersecurity Technical Architect is responsible for designing and implementing the technical components of the organization's cybersecurity strategy. This role involves creating secure systems and network architectures, selecting and configuring security technologies, and collaborating with cross‑functional teams to ensure the organization's digital assets are adequately protected.

  • Develop and implement OT cybersecurity architectures tailored for renewable energy production and operations.
  • Design secure and scalable network architectures for OT environments, including SCADA, ITS, and IoT systems.
  • Ensure OT security strategies align seamlessly with corporate IT and cybersecurity policies, while also adhering to industry standards, including IEC 62443 and ISO 27001.
  • Implement and supervise cybersecurity tools, including firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and vulnerability scanners, in OT environments.
  • Monitor and respond to OT security incidents, collaborating with incident response teams.
  • Collaborate with GRC team to address regulatory requirements.
  • Work closely with engineering, operations, and IT teams to integrate security into the lifecycle of OT assets.
  • Provide cybersecurity training and awareness programs for staff working with OT systems.
  • Engage with external vendors and partners to ensure secure deployment of third‑party OT solutions.
  • Stay updated on emerging cybersecurity threats, trends, and technologies relevant to OT environments.
  • Develop and implement strategies for continuous improvement of OT cybersecurity posture.
  • Lead pilot projects and proof‑of‑concept initiatives for new cybersecurity technologies.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCES

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in cybersecurity, with at least 2 years focusing on OT environments (e.g., SCADA, ICs).
  • Deep knowledge of OT systems and protocols, including Modbus, DNP3, OPC, and MQTT.
  • Proficiency with cybersecurity frameworks like IEC 62443, NIST CSF, and MITRE ATT&CK for ICs.
  • Familiarity with firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, and endpoint protection in OT environments.
  • Strong understanding of networking principles (e.g., VLANs, VPNs, routing).
  • Experience in renewable energy or other critical infrastructure industries is a plus.
  • CISSP, GICSP, CISM, or equivalent certifications preferred.
  • Proficiency both in Portuguese and English.
  • Availability for international travels.

KEY SKILLS

  • Strategic vision
  • Problem‑solving and organizational skills.
  • Strong ability to articulate technical concepts to non‑technical stakeholders and collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.
  • Proficiency in building relationships with internal and external partners to drive cybersecurity initiatives.
  • Resilient
  • Strong attention to detail to ensure precision in designing, implementing, and auditing cybersecurity measures.
  • Flexibility to respond to evolving cybersecurity threats and technological advancements.

description:
About MonetizeMore MonetizeMore is a Google Certified Publishing Partner and leading ad tech company that helps digital publishers maximize ad revenue through cutting‑edge technology and deep ad operations expertise. Our platform powers revenue growth for thousands of publishers worldwide—combining programmatic innovation, data intelligence, and transparent performance analytics.

We’re a fully remote, high‑impact team obsessed with empowering publishers through product‑led growth and continuous innovation.

About the Role

We’re seeking a Senior Growth Product Manager to lead the evolution of our Advanced Ads platform. This role is ideal for a data‑driven product leader with proven Product‑Led Growth (PLG) experience in SaaS or AdTech environments.

You’ll define and execute the growth strategy across acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization—using experimentation, analytics, and customer insights to turn product usage into sustained revenue growth. You’ll work at the intersection of data, technology, and customer experience, helping MonetizeMore scale through the product itself.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own growth metrics for the Advanced Ads platform (activation rate, expansion MRR, feature adoption, churn, lifetime value, etc.).
  • Drive Product‑Led Growth by designing onboarding flows, in‑product experiences, and self‑serve models that increase user activation and retention.
  • Identify and prioritize growth levers across the funnel—from self‑serve acquisition to expansion and upsell within existing publishers.
  • Lead data‑driven experimentation (A/B testing, funnel optimization, pricing tests) to accelerate growth.
  • Work closely with engineering, data science, and marketing to deliver features that increase user engagement and monetization.
  • Partner with GTM teams to create product‑driven campaigns that scale efficiently and reinforce PLG motions.
  • Collaborate with analytics and RevOps to measure performance, interpret product usage data, and turn insights into action.
  • Champion the user—understand publisher pain points, build empathy through data and research, and translate insights into high‑impact solutions.
  • Develop and evangelize growth frameworks that can be replicated across MonetizeMore’s product suite.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience, including 2+ years focused on Growth or PLG in SaaS, AdTech, or marketplace environments.
  • Proven success scaling self‑serve or freemium products using Product‑Led Growth strategies.
  • Deep understanding of digital advertising technologies—programmatic, header bidding, ad exchanges, yield optimization, and ad fraud/IVT prevention.
  • Advanced analytical skills: building dashboards, defining KPIs, running A/B tests, interpreting behavioral data.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross‑functional teams in a distributed, remote environment.
  • Excellent communication, storytelling, and stakeholder management.
  • Bonus: experience with machine learning applications in AdTech, B2B SaaS monetization, or publisher‑side products.

What You’ll Get

  • The opportunity to own PLG strategy for a high‑impact AdTech platform used by global publishers.
  • Fully remote, asynchronous work culture with a results‑first mindset.
  • Collaborative, high‑performing peers in product, engineering, data science, and ad operations.
  • Competitive compensation package with performance‑based incentives and potential equity.

Business Analysts at Nubank

As a company at the forefront of the financial revolution in Brazil, Nubank has experienced exponential growth since its inception. To keep your growth path healthy, numerous critical decisions constantly need to be made. Business Analysts are fundamental in the decision process because they must not only be able to deal with large amounts of information and data, but also always think of ways to improve our clients’ experience. It is BA's responsibility to structure the data, analyze it and use the results to test different solutions with the aim of improving Nubank’s efficiency. We are looking for people who are independent and who are not afraid to take the initiative to identify and solve problems that are not necessarily obvious. You can read more about it in our blog and get some insights into how we work.

As a Business Analyst, You’re Expected To

  • Do a lot of investigative work, focused on deciding which data makes the most sense to use in which situation. If you don’t have the data, it’s your job to think about what tests can be done or how to extract the information you need to answer your questions;
  • Support your team in making data‑based decisions by monitoring analysis and decisions, ensuring the flow of projects and making the process of taking risks comfortable despite the uncertainties;
  • Learn how to work with a large volume of data to build a solid foundation for decision making with calculated risks - even knowing that not all the answers are in the data and/or that not all the data you would like is available; Use tools like SQL, Python and Scala - taught during your first weeks with us - for data extraction;
  • Understand our products and interactions with other areas;
  • Take advantage of opportunities to grow and learn from a well‑prepared and highly qualified team;
  • Opportunity to work in a complex, dynamic and diverse environment, participating in projects that will impact a large number of clients.

  • Problem solving: ease and creativity to seek solutions to day‑to‑day challenges and achieve the best results;
  • Ability to understand how your decisions and work impact our customers’ experience, seeking results that align with our purpose;
  • Willingness and ease of learning, especially for tools;
  • Openness to receive feedback and incorporate it into your daily life and development;
  • Adaptability to the multifunctional environment;
  • Profiles that add value to Nubank’s culture.

Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Provide emergency and routine medical care to workers on board.

title: Analista Comercial III (Sr)
description:

Somos a Proper Marine , uma empresa do grupo ABL .

Fazemos parte do ABL Group , consultoria global que oferece soluções integradas em energia, engenharia, marítimas e software, promovendo segurança e sustentabilidade nos setores de renováveis, marítimo e óleo & gás.

Buscamos um(a) Analista Comercial para atuar no centro estratégico da área comercial da Proper Marine, em parceria direta com o Diretor Comercial e as lideranças técnicas da empresa.

Essa pessoa será peça-chave na estruturação, operação e expansão do nosso departamento comercial , com responsabilidade ativa na prospecção de novos negócios, organização do pipeline, elaboração de propostas e na construção de inteligência de mercado.

Na prática, será alguém que vai caminhar lado a lado com os(as) Coordenadores(as) de Projetos — que hoje acumulam parte das atividades comerciais — assumindo esse papel com foco, consistência e protagonismo .

  • Prospecção ativa de novos negócios e clientes , com abordagem estratégica e técnica, especialmente no setor de engenharia naval, offshore e óleo & gás;

  • Elaboração e gestão de propostas comerciais , incluindo entendimento técnico do escopo, formatação de valores, precificação, prazos e envio;

  • Atuação próxima aos times de projetos, engenharia, jurídico e financeiro , garantindo alinhamento entre proposta e execução;

  • Interação direta com o Diretor Comercial , apoiando decisões estratégicas com dados, análise de oportunidades e insights de mercado;

  • Acompanhamento de contratos , em conjunto com jurídico e engenharia, para garantir entrega conforme escopo e expectativas.

    • Formação superior completa em Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas;

    • Inglês avançado ou fluente (obrigatório, será testado) – será utilizado em interações globais, propostas e relatórios;

    • Mínimo de 6 anos de experiência na área comercial , preferencialmente em empresas de engenharia, projetos ou serviços técnicos;

    • Desejável experiência no setor naval, offshore ou óleo & gás ;

    • Domínio de ferramentas de CRM (preferência para Zoho), Excel e PowerPoint;

    • Capacidade analítica para elaboração de propostas, modelagem de custos e tomada de decisão baseada em dados;

    • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, relacionamento e negociação ;

    • Perfil hands-on, proativo, dinâmico, com foco em resultado e organização de processos ;

    • Disponibilidade para modelo presencial durante os 6 primeiros meses (fase de integração); após esse período, o modelo de trabalho será híbrido .

Por que escolher a Proper Marine?

Aqui na Proper Marine, você vai encontrar mais do que um emprego — vai encontrar um ambiente que acolhe, incentiva e impulsiona o seu crescimento. Nosso time é colaborativo, com uma cultura que valoriza a troca de conhecimento e o aprendizado constante, porque acreditamos que o desenvolvimento individual fortalece o sucesso coletivo.

Benefícios de fazer parte do nosso time:

  • Ambiente acolhedor, colaborativo e focado no seu desenvolvimento constante

  • Espírito de equipe forte, com cultura de troca e apoio mútuo

  • Plano de carreira estruturado, com PDI para apoiar sua evolução profissional

  • Aulas presenciais de inglês e espanhol no escritório, sem custo ?

  • Wellhub para o seu bem-estar ?

  • Horário flexível para equilibrar sua rotina ⏰

  • Prêmio Proper Performance ligado à avaliação de desempenho ?

  • Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos globais, com pessoas do mundo todo ?

  • Reconhecimento e valorização do seu talento e esforço, com incentivo constante ao crescimento profissional

Na Proper Marine, respeitamos e valorizamos a diversidade e a inclusão , acreditando que nossas equipes são a chave para a inovação e o sucesso sustentável.

Aqui, o seu talento é a força que impulsiona a inovação e o sucesso da Proper Marine no Brasil e além. Vamos construir esse futuro juntos!

title: BANCO DE TALENTOS - EXCLUSIVO PARA PCD | COMPLEXO BARATINHA Antônio Dias - MG Talent pool
description:
Na Bemisa, todas as candidaturas são bem-vindas, independente de etnia, religião, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, idade, nacionalidade ou deficiência.

Valorizamos um ambiente em que todos se sintam engajados e capazes de contribuir com suas habilidades para impulsionar nosso crescimento.

E para continuar construindo uma cultura inclusiva e diversa, contamos com a candidatura de bons profissionais como você para as futuras oportunidades na nossa empresa.

Modelo de trabalho

Área Operacional: Formato presencial com atuação em horário administrativo ou escala de turno;

Área Corporativa: Formato híbrido com atuação presencial quatro dias por semana e um dia home office.

Você está se candidatando ao nosso Banco de Talentos , criado exclusivamente para pessoas com deficiência que desejam desenvolver o seu potencial, explorar diversas áreas de atuação e conhecer mais sobre o setor de mineração.

Assim que surgir uma oportunidade alinhada ao seu perfil, entraremos em contato. Enquanto isso, mantenha seu currículo atualizado para que possamos conhecer mais sobre você.

As vagas serão para as regiões:

  1. Belo Horizonte/MG
  2. Água Azul do Norte/PA
  3. Rio de Janeiro/RJ

Benefícios

Nosso atuais benefícios são:

  • Plano de Saúde (Titular e dependentes);
  • Assistência Funeral;
  • Refeição Local;
  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Wellhub - Plataforma de atividades físicas e bem estar;
  • Apoiopass - Programa especial de apoio e cuidado para colaboradores e familiares;
  • Programa Empresa Cidadã - Licença maternidade de 6 meses e paternidade de 20 dias.

*Os benefícios podem sofrer alteração de acordo com a região da vaga.

Com 17 anos de experiência, atualmente estamos presentes em todas as regiões do país, com um portfólio diversificado que engloba uma ampla gama de minerais, tais como minério de ferro, ouro, níquel, terras raras, fosfato e calcário.

Possuímos projetos em diferentes etapas da atividade mineral, desde a fase de exploração até a operação, e contamos com cerca de 1000 colaboradores por todo o Brasil engajados em nosso propósito.

A Mina Baratinha, localizada no Vale do Aço em Minas Gerais, possui uma capacidade de produção de aproximadamente 2,5 milhões de toneladas anuais de minério de ferro de alto teor e baixos níveis de contaminantes. Além disso, em julho de 2023, demos início à implantação do Projeto Mongais, com capacidade de produção de 1,0 milhão de toneladas por ano, dentro do Complexo de Baratinha. Já em Água Azul, primeira operação de ouro do Grupo Bemisa, está localizada no sul do Pará e iniciou sua fase de comissionamento em 2023.

Acreditamos no potencial da mineração do Brasil e temos como compromisso a integração da sustentabilidade em nossas operações, gerando desenvolvimento socioeconômico em todas as regiões em que atuamos.

title: Model Risk Specialist
description:
About Us

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 122 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building.

Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human.

Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page

About The Team

At Nubank we heavily rely on data, machine learning and other quantitative models & techniques to drive our strategy and provide the best experience and products to our customers. The position holder will be part of the Model Risk team, within the Risk Management structure at Nubank.

The Model Risk team is the second line of defense for our models. Our mission is to ensure Nubank relies on world-class solutions that will lead to optimal and sustainable decisions. We act by providing independent review & challenge to models, staying tuned to cutting edge techniques, along with business, customers and regulatory needs. We also work to identify and control risks related to our models, as well as in the definition and implementation of feedback loops to constantly improve them.

About The Role

This is a senior individual contributor position, in which you will:

  • Conduct independent reviews of quantitative models based on various financial, statistical and machine learning techniques, identifying and validating model's uses, hypothesis, data, methodologies and compliance with regulatory requirements.
  • Provide effective challenges, identify risks and enhancement opportunities, and engage with other analysts to strengthen our decision making tools.
  • Develop playbooks and toolkits (Python, Scala, LLM, etc.) to optimize model reviews, ongoing models monitoring, and assess the impact of models in decisions.
  • Contribute to the consolidation of Nubank's Model Risk Management and Model Review frameworks with autonomy and creativity.
  • Discuss and report model risk status and independent opinions on models with different stakeholders, including senior managers and regulators.
  • Be exposed to different types of decisions and processes (e.g. credit, fraud, operations and in different countries).
  • Ensure the team maintains a high level of technical excellence.
  • Work in a multicultural, diverse and highly skilled environment.

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience developing or validating quantitative and/or machine learning models used to leverage important decision-making processes or to solve relevant academic problems.
  • Interest in reviewing complex machine learning and other types of models to identify risks and propose enhancements.
  • Data Science skills, strong knowledge on machine learning tools and techniques.
  • Proactive, autonomous and ability to learn fast, with strong analytical and problem-solving skills, motivated by challenges.
  • Organized and detail-oriented, without losing track of the big picture.
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and effectively discuss complex topics with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualification

  • Academic or professional experience in statistical and mathematical model application and/or validation.
  • Experience in credit risk management and/or other risk management frameworks.
  • Master degree or relevant undergraduate scientific project.
  • Financial or risk certificate (FRM or CFA).
  • Previous experience with programming languages and tools (Python, SQL, Scala, Databricks, Github, Cursor).

title: Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Core
description:
6 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring technical engineering manager to redefine the embedded Linux experience with the smallest, most secure, and most reliable operating system in the IoT market.
This is an opportunity for a technical leader passionate about open source software, Linux, containers, security, and the developer experience, to shape the future of Linux from the smallest systems up to desktops. This challenging role demands a high degree of technical skill as well as high caliber for inspiring and driving people.
Our mission is to allow everyone to build robust solutions in various fields including but not limited to IoT, automotive, and aviation using the next generation secure embedded Linux operating system in a simple solution. We define a reliable and secure set of device recovery mechanisms that enable device manufacturers to simplify and standardize the field operations for fleets of heterogeneous appliances.
As an engineering manager, you'll lead a team of strong software developers to design and implement Ubuntu Core system software on various CPU architectures, such as ARM, RISC-V, and X86. You will meet stakeholders, prioritize requests, plan the roadmap and ensure the team can deliver their goals. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.

The role entails

  • Building and leading a distributed team of engineers through hiring, coaching, mentoring, feedback and career development
  • Demonstrating sound engineering principles by directly contributing toward your team's goals
  • Coaching and mentoring team members with hands‑on career development
  • Effectively setting and managing expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Advocating and advancing modern, agile software development practices and helping develop and evangelize great engineering and organizational practices
  • Contributing to a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Actively participating in the leadership team and collaborating with other leaders in the organisation

What we are looking for in you

  • Demonstrated competencies in embedded software development
  • Strong skills in Golang, C++ and Shell
  • A solid understanding of Linux and a modern GNU/Linux distribution, Debian or Ubuntu preferred
  • Love for developing and growing people and have a track record of doing it
  • Demonstrated ability of planning and executing to deliver high quality software in a timely manner
  • Solid experience working in an agile development environment
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills

Nice-to-have skills

  • Familiarity with an immutable Linux distribution, preferably Ubuntu Core
  • Experience with multiple CPU architectures such as ARM, RISC-V
  • Experience with Linux native containerization and security

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Financiamento de projetos de infraestrutura tem sido uma das nossas principais especialidades desde nossa fundação. Nossa equipe atuou em operações pioneiras, como, por exemplo, o primeiro project finance internacional limited‑recourse para projeto greenfield, o primeiro project finance non‑recourse para produção de petróleo, o primeiro project bond internacional e o primeiro bond internacional lastreado em royalties de petróleo.

Entre nossos clientes estão as maiores instituições financeiras mundiais, bancos de desenvolvimento, agências multilaterais, agências de crédito à exportação (ECAs) e fundos de investimento, bem como os empreendedores, sponsors, offtakers e construtoras mais ativas e atuantes nesse mercado.

About MonetizeMore

MonetizeMore enables digital publishers to build sustainable businesses by maximizing their advertising revenue with privacy‑first, cutting‑edge ad tech. We are a fully remote, globally distributed team that values ownership, curiosity, and continuous improvement.

The Role

We’re looking for a Software Engineer (WordPress) with strong PHP and WordPress experience to help us build, scale, and maintain high‑performance publisher sites and WordPress‑based products that integrate with our ad tech stack. You’ll collaborate with product managers, designers, and other engineers to ship features end‑to‑end in an agile, asynchronous environment.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain custom WordPress plugins and themes using modern PHP.
  • Build REST APIs and integrations with internal services and third‑party platforms (analytics, ad tech, SSO, etc.).
  • Optimize performance (Core Web Vitals), security, and reliability across high‑traffic sites.
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines, automated tests, and code quality tooling.
  • Diagnose and resolve production issues; participate in an on‑call rotation (reasonable schedule, follow‑the‑sun).
  • Partner with stakeholders to estimate effort, break down work, and deliver iterative value.
  • Contribute to engineering standards, documentation, and knowledge sharing.

You’ll Thrive Here If You

  • Enjoy owning features from design to deployment.
  • Communicate clearly in an async, remote‑first culture (Slack, docs, PRs).
  • Care about developer experience, code quality, and maintainability.

Qualifications

Must‑Haves

  • 2–3 years professional experience building WordPress sites, plugins, or products.
  • Solid PHP (7.x/8.x) fundamentals and familiarity with modern patterns (OOP, namespaces, Composer, PSR standards).
  • Strong WordPress expertise: hooks/filters, custom post types, WP‑CLI, multisite, Gutenberg/Block Editor.
  • Frontend proficiency: HTML5, CSS/Sass, JavaScript/TypeScript, React for Gutenberg blocks.
  • Experience with MySQL/MariaDB, query optimization, and caching (Object Cache/Redis, page caching).
  • Git/GitHub (PR reviews, trunk‑based or GitFlow), CI/CD fundamentals.
  • Performance and security best practices (Core Web Vitals, CWEs/OWASP, nonces/capabilities).
  • Comfortable working across time zones in a remote team.

Nice‑to‑Haves

  • Experience with ad tech (Google Ad Manager, Prebid, header bidding) or analytics (GA4, Looker Studio).
  • Infrastructure experience: Docker, Nginx/Apache, Varnish, Cloudflare, AWS/GCP.
  • Automated testing in the WP/PHP ecosystem (PHPUnit, Pest, Playwright, Cypress).
  • Familiarity with SEO, internationalization (i18n/l10n), and accessibility (WCAG).
  • Experience with telemetry/observability (Logrocket/Sentry, OpenTelemetry, Datadog/New Relic).

Example Projects You Might Own

  • Build a privacy‑aware custom plugin that injects ad placements conditionally based on consent signals (TCF/US Privacy) and viewability.
  • Migrate legacy shortcodes to Gutenberg blocks with React and server‑side rendering for performance.
  • Implement an edge‑cache strategy and object caching to reduce TTFB and improve LCP across high‑traffic pages.
  • Create a small service that syncs WP content with internal APIs; expose a hardened REST endpoint for partners.

Sobre a Michelin

A Michelin, líder do segmento de pneus, se dedica ao desenvolvimento da mobilidade de seus clientes, de forma sustentável, criando e distribuindo os pneus, serviços e soluções mais adequados às suas necessidades, fornecendo serviços digitais, mapas e guias, para ajudar a tornar suas viagens experiências únicas; e desenvolvendo materiais de alta tecnologia, que atendem à indústria da mobilidade.

Defendemos nossos valores de respeito aos clientes, às pessoas, aos acionistas, ao meio ambiente e aos fatos em todos os lugares onde estamos presentes.

Nós nos importamos em dar as pessoas uma melhor maneira de seguir em frente.

Seja parte de um time no qual você é empoderado e encorajado a alcançar o seu potencial ao máximo e a realizar as suas ambições.

Ao redor do mundo, através da diversidade, ajude a criar o futuro da Michelin com paixão, entusiasmo e orgulho.

Com a mesma atenção aos nossos colaboradores e clientes, nós inovamos além e melhor pela sustentabilidade.

Valorizamos as singularidades de cada um e consideramos a diversidade como um valor, por isso reforçamos este convite para você, que se autodeclara negro ou negra, do gênero feminino ou masculino, LGBTQIA+, pessoa com deficiência ou acima de 50 anos.

Missão do Cargo

Para os projetos de investimento industrial de seu perímetro, disponibilizar os equipamentos necessários para atingir os objetivos do projeto com a melhor relação desempenho/custo, utilizando os padrões.

  • Conduzir os pré-estudos para definir as soluções mais eficientes.
  • Pilotar a concepção ou a integração, respeitando as melhores práticas do departamento (normas internas, externas, sistema de qualidade, capitalização, arquivamento) em colaboração com todas as áreas relacionadas.
  • Pilotar a realização, a instalação e colocar em funcionamento.

Principais Realizações Esperadas

  • Estudos de viabilidade feitos com CDCs desafiados e validados, avaliando soluções sob custos, prazos, riscos e critérios funcionais;
  • Estudos de integração realizados em cooperação com outros departamentos;
  • Solicitações de mudanças gerenciadas conforme o processo de DE/Release;
  • Sistema de qualidade e métodos implementados (análises de risco, AMDEC, revisão de design, planejamento de qualidade, DTE, tratamento de Não Conformidades, etc.);
  • Validações obtidas após fases de realização, instalação, inicialização e desenvolvimento dos equipamentos em colaboração com os departamentos relacionados;
  • Apoio aos projetos de protótipos das equipes de desenvolvimento de processos.

Perfil Desejado

  • Graduação Engenharia Elétrica, Eletrônica ou Automação (Técnico em Elétrica, Eletrônica, Automação ou Eletromecânica)
  • Experiência em projetos industriais;
  • Conhecimento em normas internas e externas, sistemas de qualidade e ferramentas como AMDEC (FMEA);
  • Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe e conduzir projetos multidisciplinares;
  • Inglês Intermediário/Avançado;

Benefícios

  • Plano de saúde e odontológico
  • Vale-alimentação
  • Programa de participação nos resultados
  • Seguro de vida
  • Ambiente colaborativo e oportunidades de desenvolvimento

Ética de Recrutamento

Atenção: Informamos que não contratamos empresas terceiras que cobrem dos candidatos para a participação em nossos processos. Caso tenha dúvidas, procure nossos canais oficiais ou nossos recrutadores.

MUITO MAIS QUE UMA STARTUP ⚡

Somos um hub de serviços e produtos financeiros escaláveis.

Main responsibilities

O dia a dia:

  • Realizar análises de dados, identificando padrões e gerando insights que apoiem as áreas de negócio, com escopo moderado e complexidade intermediária.
